verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable auth webhooks or event streams for sign-ups, sign-ins, or user changes. It only mentions connecting auth data to your own tables via Postgres triggers and customizing Auth behavior with Postgres functions at lifecycle points. These are developer building blocks and adjacent customization hooks, not an outbound event subscription capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to webhooks or event streams for auth events (sign-ups, sign-ins, user changes) to keep my systems in sync

citations.quote: You can connect this data to your own tables using triggers and foreign key references.
Customize Auth behavior with Postgres functions at key lifecycle points.
